title: Evaluation of the layered circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean DAG circuit on $n$ inputs whose gates have distinct arguments and whose NOT gates each have exactly one argument. Suppose no gate of $C$ is an OR gate. For every Boolean input assignment $x$, the value of the associated layered circuit, whose output type has a unique element, equals the output value of $C$, with Boolean values encoded in $\mathrm{Fin}\,2$.
hypotheses_covered: C is a DAG circuit on n inputs
Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
No gate is an OR gate
